description: Universal Event Tracking requests to the Microsoft Advertising collection endpoint. Microsoft documents ti, ver, evt, mid, and rn on every event, plus pageLoad kl and tw, custom-event pagetype, prodid, search_term, ecomm_category, transaction_id, and items, ecommerce ecomm_pagetype, ecomm_prodid, ecomm_totalvalue, and ecomm_query, and flight_destid, flight_originid, flight_pagetype, flight_startdate, flight_enddate, and flight_totalvalue.

params.name: ti
params.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID. Microsoft documents ti as required on every event.
params.fix_hint: Copy the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising into the tag snippet.

params.name: ver
params.description: It is the UET tag version. Microsoft documents ver as required, and 2.3 for a custom implementation.
params.fix_hint: Send ver as 2.3 on a custom implementation, or the version the generated snippet reports.

params.name: evt
params.description: It names the event. Microsoft documents evt as required, and only pageLoad or custom.
params.fix_hint: Send evt=pageLoad on a page view, or evt=custom on a custom event.

params.name: mid
params.description: It identifies events from a single page. Microsoft documents mid as a unique identifier that must change when the page changes.
params.fix_hint: Send a fresh mid per page, such as a GUID.

params.name: rn
params.description: It is a cache buster. Microsoft documents rn as a required random 6-digit number.
params.fix_hint: Send a random 6-digit rn on every fire.

params.name: p
params.description: It is the page URL. Microsoft documents p on pageLoad events, and as mandatory when page URL remarketing lists are used.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in p.

params.name: r
params.description: It is the referrer URL. Microsoft documents r on pageLoad events.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in r, or omit it.

params.name: uid
params.description: It is a customer-defined logged-in user ID that stays the same across browsers and devices.

params.name: vid
params.description: It is a customer-defined anonymous user ID.

params.name: msclkid
params.description: It is the Microsoft Click ID. Microsoft documents a 32-hex GUID plus -0 or -1, an optional N when cookies are blocked, or N alone when no click exists.
params.fix_hint: Forward the _uetmsclkid cookie as {guid}-0 or {guid}-1, or send N when there is no click.

params.name: kl
params.description: It is the page title. Microsoft documents kl on pageLoad events.
params.fix_hint: Send the page title in kl, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: tw
params.description: It is the SEO meta keywords for the current page. Microsoft documents tw on pageLoad events.
params.fix_hint: Send the page keywords in tw, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: pagetype
params.description: It is the page type on a custom event. Microsoft documents Cart, Category, Home, Other, Product, Purchase, and Search results.
params.fix_hint: Send a documented pagetype such as Purchase or Product.

params.name: prodid
params.description: It is a comma-separated list of product IDs. Microsoft documents prodid as matching the ID or item_group_id in the MMC product feed.
params.fix_hint: Send one or more product IDs, comma-separated, such as Prod123456.

params.name: search_term
params.description: It is the search query that led to the search results page. Microsoft documents search_term on custom events.
params.fix_hint: Send the search query in search_term, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ecomm_category
params.description: It is the category ID on a category browse page. Microsoft documents ecomm_category on custom events.
params.fix_hint: Send the category ID in ecomm_category, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: It is a unique transaction ID. Microsoft documents transaction_id on custom events.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique transaction ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: items
params.description: It is the product array on a custom event. Microsoft documents `items` as a JSON array of objects with `id`, `quantity`, and `price`.
params.fix_hint: Send `items` as a JSON array, such as `[{"id":"Prod123456","quantity":2,"price":25.1}]`.

params.name: ecomm_pagetype
params.description: It is the ecommerce page type. Microsoft documents home, searchresults, category, product, cart, purchase, and other.
params.fix_hint: Send a documented ecomm_pagetype such as purchase or product.

params.name: ecomm_prodid
params.description: It is the product ID list for dynamic remarketing. Microsoft documents ecomm_prodid as matching the feed id or item_group_id.
params.fix_hint: Send one or more product IDs in ecomm_prodid, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ecomm_totalvalue
params.description: It is the cart or purchase total. Microsoft documents ecomm_totalvalue as a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 50.20, with no currency symbol.

params.name: ecomm_query
params.description: It is the search query on a search-results page. Microsoft documents ecomm_query on custom events.
params.fix_hint: Send the search query in ecomm_query, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ec
params.description: It is the custom event category. Microsoft documents ec on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: ea
params.description: It is the custom event action. Microsoft documents ea on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: el
params.description: It is the custom event label. Microsoft documents el on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: ev
params.description: It is the custom event value. Microsoft documents ev as numeric, on custom events only.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 42, not a currency string.

params.name: flight_destid
params.description: It is the flight destination ID. Microsoft documents flight_destid on the travel parameter table.
params.fix_hint: Send the destination ID in flight_destid, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: flight_originid
params.description: It is the flight origin ID. Microsoft documents flight_originid on the travel parameter table.
params.fix_hint: Send the origin ID in flight_originid, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: flight_pagetype
params.description: It is the flight page type. Microsoft documents flight_pagetype on the travel parameter table.
params.fix_hint: Send the flight page type in flight_pagetype, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: flight_startdate
params.description: It is the flight start date. Microsoft documents flight_startdate on the travel parameter table.
params.fix_hint: Send the start date in flight_startdate, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: flight_enddate
params.description: It is the flight end date. Microsoft documents flight_enddate on the travel parameter table.
params.fix_hint: Send the end date in flight_enddate, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: flight_totalvalue
params.description: It is the flight total value. Microsoft documents flight_totalvalue on the travel parameter table. Other UET value fields are numbers with no currency symbol.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 249.00, with no currency symbol.

params.name: gv
params.description: It is variable revenue for conversion tracking.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 20.55, with no currency symbol.

params.name: gc
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of gv.
params.fix_hint: Send the three-letter code, such as USD.

rules.message: A pageLoad event carries a custom-event field. Microsoft documents ec, ea, el, and ev as custom-event parameters that cannot be used with pageLoad.
rules.fix_hint: Drop ec, ea, el, and ev from pageLoad, or set evt=custom.
